header:
# Town of Tunbridge municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Article 1 re-elected Israel Provoncha as Moderator
Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Mike McPhetres won the three-year selectboard seat in 2026
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists Gary Mullen (Chair), John O'Brien, and Mike McPhetres
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Bonnie McCrillis as Tunbridge's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Bonnie McCrillis as Tunbridge's Town Clerk; her seat did not stand in 2026
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Rebecca Hoyt as Tunbridge's Town Treasurer
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists Rebecca Hoyt as Treasurer (the treasurer contact spreadsheet carries no Tunbridge row)

Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Christine Battcock won the three-year lister seat in 2026; the minutes' Article 11 line for the two-year seat is blank in the document itself, but the same minutes present Daniel Ruddell and Deb Mullen as sitting listers
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists Christine Battcock, Deb Mullen, and Daniel Ruddell as the three listers
Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Linda Hoyt won an auditor seat in 2026
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists Linda Hoyt, Betsy Race, and Anissa Morrison as the three auditors
Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Dennis Cilley won a cemetery commissioner seat in 2026
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists Dennis Cilley, Ben Tucker, and Baxter Doty as the three cemetery commissioners

sources.note: Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Matthew Frost won a trustee of public funds seat in 2026
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists Matthew Frost, Liz York, and Laura Ginsburg as the three trustees of public funds
Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Elise Gabriel and Liz Williams won library trustee seats in 2026 (Williams succeeding Cheryl Metcalf)
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists five library trustees

sources.note: Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Joseph Paquin was re-elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes; Article 4 separately authorized the Treasurer under 32 V.S.A. section 4791 to collect current taxes
Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Roger Clark was elected First Constable
Town of Tunbridge, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (signed; town website): Mike O'Donnell was elected Second Constable (the 2025 report showed the second seat vacant)
Town of Tunbridge, 2025 Annual Report, 'Elected Town Officers' page (town website): lists Lenora Kimball as Grand Juror

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Tunbridge Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Tunbridge justices of the peace: Gordon Barnaby, Helen O'Donnell, Rob Howe, Judy Howe, Jonathan Bicknell, John O'Brien, and Margaret Rogers. The 2025 Annual Report's officers page concurs; it gives Rob Howe's full form as Robert Howe
